System

Mining and woodcutting with exclusive claims

Mining and woodcutting share one validated action/claim pipeline but use different tool, animation, profession and yield definitions. Two clients contesting one node cannot both receive its exclusive depleted-generation reward.

Scope and player interaction

Mining and woodcutting share one validated action/claim pipeline but use different tool, animation, profession and yield definitions. Two clients contesting one node cannot both receive its exclusive depleted-generation reward.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase12committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Idle → Validating → Reserved → Gathering → CommitPending → Succeeded → Canceled → Rejected

WBP_Gathering observes results from URPGGatheringComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_GatherRule_Mining. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
GatherActionId: server-generated action identity; command receipt ID stable at completion
NodeId and NodeGeneration: resolve current active source
RequiredToolCategory and MinimumProfessionLevel: authored per resource
StartPosition/StartServerTime/DurationSeconds: server action facts
ReservationOwner/Expiry: transient exclusive action lease; never itself a reward
YieldDefinitionIds, QuantityRange and ProfessionXP: server-selected content rules
CancelOnMove/Hit/Death/Travel/ToolChange: explicit flags

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGGatheringComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_GatheringLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RequestGather(CommandId, NodeActor, ExpectedGeneration) -> Started|ResourceBusy|WrongTool|SkillRequired
CancelGather(ActionId, Reason) -> Canceled|AlreadyTerminal
CompleteGather(ActionId) -> GrantReceipt|NodeDepleted|NoSpace|Interrupted; server timer only
ObserveGatherState(ActionId) -> ProgressAndReason; local/replicated presentation

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Character_A and Character_B press Interact on OreSite_A01. Server checks range/LOS, active generation, pickaxe ownership, mining skill and action state.
  2. The zone serializes reservation acquisition: A wins; B receives ResourceBusy and no materials/XP. Reservations expire/cancel safely if A moves away.
  3. Server advances a 3-second mining action. The p2 tool pose is cosmetic; a missing/late hit-frame notify cannot finish the action or award ore.
  4. At completion repeat tool/range/alive/generation checks and capacity plan. Backend transaction locks node generation and character, marks depleted, grants resolved ore plus mining XP and stores receipt atomically.
  5. After commit replicate node depletion to both clients, update A's inventory/profession UI, and schedule persisted respawn. B's subsequent request receives NodeDepleted.
  6. For TreeSite_W03 repeat with Axe, woodcutting profession, biome-specific AshLog yields and chopping visual mapping. Invalid terrain sites are never spawned.
  7. On timeout after commit, quarantine that action/node from conflicting mutations and reconcile the original receipt. Restart reads depleted state; no second grant.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DA_GatherRule_Mining and DA_GatherRule_Woodcutting with tool tags, durations, yield tables and profession IDs. Add corresponding material definitions created in Phase 09.
  2. Add URPGGatheringComponent once to BP_PlayerCharacter and expose RequestGather/CancelGather as guarded custom commands.
  3. Configure BP_ResourceNode with source identity, resource definition and interaction interface; it does not own a copy of player inventory.
  4. Assign WBP_Gathering to ScreenRouter's nonmodal progress layer. Show target, progress, cancel prompt and structured rejection; input remains responsive but movement cancels under default rule.
  5. Reopen resource director to consume committed depletion, inventory service to plan yield capacity, profession component to apply receipt XP, and PaperZD mappings for mining/chopping p2 only after actual archive audit.
  6. Test both clients against one node, one full inventory, one missing tool, one moving player and a backend response dropped after commit.

Reopen Phase12 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / OreSite_A01 / TreeSite_W03 / Character_A / Character_B. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Two simultaneous starts -> one reservation; one ResourceBusy.
A cancels/moves/dies -> reservation released, no materials/XP; B can start if node remains active.
Completion races with stale generation -> NodeDepleted/StaleGeneration, no grant.
Full bag -> NoSpace before depletion commit; node stays active and reservation releases.
Server restart after accepted depletion -> ore/log remains granted once; respawn uses stored due time.
Repeated bot-like requests -> rate limited without issuing duplicate actions; avoid punishing packet retries as new activity.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Mining duration 3 s, woodcutting 4 s, yield 2 CopperOre or 3 AshLog, profession XP 5, respawn 180 s are fixture proposals. Optional herbalism may reuse this path only after its content/art/tool policy is approved.

Log node/site/generation/action/character/receipt and cancellation reason. Progress has text and audio-optional cues; tool animation is not the only indication. Track acquisition rate and contention for economy tuning.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
